title: Structured Reasoning for Fairness: A Multi-Agent Approach to Bias Detection in Textual Data
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and technical evaluation of a multi-agent framework for detecting linguistic bias (fact vs. opinion) in textual datasets. While it mentions 'fairness' and 'accountability' as goals, it does not include a specific component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethical frameworks.
